# Input

Single-line text input. Use `Input.Password` for passwords, `Input.Search` for searching and `Input.TextArea`
for multi-line text. Filled input: neutral background without a border; on focus it shows a thin accent border
and a focus halo.

`Input.Search` shows the search icon at the start of the field and has no attached button: pressing `Enter`
searches, and clearing the field with `allowClear` also calls `onSearch`.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Form fields, search fields in toolbars, entering a name in a dialog

## Import

```ts
import { Input } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Single-line text, password, search and multi-line text.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Input placeholder="Project name" />
      <Input.Password placeholder="Password" />
      <Input.Search placeholder="Search projects" allowClear />
      <Input.TextArea placeholder="Notes" autoSize={{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 6 }} />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Search

The search icon sits at the start inside the box, with no attached button: `Enter` triggers `onSearch`, and with
`allowClear` the clear button triggers it with an empty string as well. While `loading`, the icon becomes a
loading indicator and `Enter` does not trigger it again.

```tsx
export function Search() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Input.Search placeholder="Search by name, press Enter" allowClear onSearch={setQ} />
      <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
        {q ? `Searching for "${q}"` : 'No search yet'}
      </Text>
      <Input.Search placeholder="Searching" loading defaultValue="Alex Morgan" />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### Tabular numbers

Add `numeric` to inputs for amounts, quantities and IDs: digits have the same width, which makes values easier to
align and check. Pass amounts as strings, never as floating-point numbers.

```tsx
export function Numeric() {
  return <Input numeric placeholder="0.00" defaultValue="12800.50" />
}
```

## States

### Disabled and error

```tsx
export function States() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Input disabled value="Read only" />
      <Input status="error" defaultValue="Name already exists" />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prefix` | `ReactNode` | Content before the text, inside the field, such as an icon. | — | No |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'email' \| 'tel' \| 'url' \| 'search' \| 'date' \| 'datetime-local' \| 'time' \| 'month'` | Native input type, such as `email`, `tel` or `url`. The date and time types show the browser's own picker; prefer DatePicker and TimePicker for a consistent look. | `'text'` | No |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | Tabular numbers for numeric input such as amounts, quantities and reference numbers: every digit has the same width, which makes values easy to align and check (same as `<Text numeric>`). | — | No |
| `ref` | `Ref<InputRef>` | Handle of the field. | — | No |
| `value` | `string` | Current text (controlled). | — | No |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | Initial text (uncontrolled). | — | No |
| `onChange` | `(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | Called on every change of the text, with the native change event (`e.target.value`). | — | No |
| `onPressEnter` | `(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | Called when `Enter` is pressed. | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density. | — | No |
| `status` | `'error' \| 'warning'` | Validation status, usually set by Form.Item: `error` or `warning` colors the field. | — | No |
| `variant` | `'filled' \| 'borderless'` | Appearance: `filled` (neutral background, the default) or `borderless` (no background, for fields inside other surfaces such as a command palette). | `'filled'` | No |
| `allowClear` | `boolean` | Shows a clear button while the field has text. | — | No |
| `suffix` | `ReactNode` | Content after the text, inside the field, such as a unit. | — | No |

Also accepts the attributes of the native element (`InputHTMLAttributes`), such as `disabled` and `onClick`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
